meta.title: SafeDeal — Peer-to-peer escrow for Thailand
meta.description: SafeDeal holds the money safely until you get your item, then pays the seller. Buy and sell person-to-person without the risk of a scam.

trust.h: Trust that's built in, not promised.
trust.lead: Every part of a deal is protected by design — money, identity, evidence, and data.
trust.i0h: A licensed provider holds the money
trust.i0b: Funds sit with Omise (Opn), a licensed payment provider. SafeDeal never touches your money directly.
trust.i1b: If the seller never ships, the money comes back to the buyer automatically.
trust.i2b: Identity checks (KYC) reduce impersonation and fakes on both sides.
trust.i3b: Creation, payment, shipping and release are timestamped — a full, visible trail.
trust.i4b: Sensitive data is encrypted at rest, handled under Thailand's PDPA.
trust.i5h: Disputes decided by a real admin
trust.i5b: If something goes wrong, a person reviews the evidence — not a bot.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of SafeDeal's peer-to-peer escrow service. By creating an account or accepting a deal, you agree to them.

sections.title: 1. The service
sections.body: SafeDeal provides a platform that records deal terms and coordinates funds held through our payment provider. SafeDeal is not the buyer, seller, courier, or manufacturer of an item and does not guarantee its quality or legality.

sections.title: 2. Your account
sections.body: You must provide accurate information, protect your sign-in credentials, and promptly tell us about unauthorized access. You may not use SafeDeal for unlawful, fraudulent, or prohibited transactions.

sections.title: 3. Deals and escrow
sections.body: A deal becomes binding when both parties accept its recorded terms. The buyer authorizes collection of the agreed amount. Funds are released or refunded only under the accepted deal flow, an applicable timeout, or a dispute decision.

sections.title: 4. Shipping and disputes
sections.body: Each party must provide truthful evidence and meet the deadlines shown in the deal. SafeDeal may review messages, shipment evidence, payment records, and other relevant information to resolve a dispute.

sections.title: 5. Fees and payment provider
sections.body: Applicable fees are shown before acceptance. Payment processing and custody are provided by Opn Payments (Omise) and may also be subject to its terms and verification requirements.

sections.title: 6. Suspension and liability
sections.body: We may restrict accounts or transactions to prevent harm, comply with law, or investigate suspected abuse. Nothing in these terms excludes rights or liability that cannot legally be excluded under Thai law.

sections.title: 7. Contact and governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Thailand. Contact SafeDeal support with questions, complaints, or notices. This product notice must receive Thai legal counsel review before production launch.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains how SafeDeal handles personal data under Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).

sections.title: 1. Data we collect
sections.body: We process account identifiers, verified contact details, deal and payment references, shipping information, evidence, device and security logs, consent records, and support communications. We minimize the data retained by SafeDeal.

sections.title: 2. Why we use it
sections.body: We use personal data to provide and secure escrow transactions, verify users, communicate deal events, prevent fraud, resolve disputes, comply with legal duties, and improve the service. Marketing is optional and based on separate consent.

sections.title: 3. Service providers and transfers
sections.body: Clerk provides authentication and may process account data outside Thailand under contractual safeguards. Opn Payments processes payments. Infrastructure and communication providers process only the data needed to deliver their services.

sections.title: 4. Retention and security
sections.body: We retain data only as long as needed for the service, disputes, fraud prevention, and legal obligations. Sensitive retained data is encrypted, access is restricted, and security-relevant actions are logged.

sections.title: 5. Your rights
sections.body: Subject to the PDPA, you may request access, correction, portability, objection, restriction, deletion, or withdrawal of consent. Withdrawing optional consent does not affect processing already lawfully performed.

sections.title: 6. Contact
sections.body: Contact SafeDeal support to exercise a privacy right or ask a question. You may also complain to Thailand's Personal Data Protection Committee. This notice must receive Thai legal counsel review before production launch.
